notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i needim subjekt bilong נמצא, Hibru i no gat

notes.subject: ויגאלו
notes.rationale: root גאל: 'ol i senis/bagarapim ol' (KJV/ASV 'polluted') o YLT 'redeemed' — pasin bilong mi holim tet 'senisim'

notes.subject: skru i no painim
notes.rationale: ol samting hait — ol skru bilong ol lain i stap hait, ol i no save olsem

translation: Ol dispela i painim ⟨את⟩ skru bilong ol long lain bilong ol i bin makim long skru, tasol ⟨em⟩ i no painim; olsem ol i senisim ol na rausim ol long wok bilong pris.

tokens.gloss: lain bilong ol i bin makim long skru
